Since the start of the war, Iran took the stance of retaliating only when the US attacked. It was tit-for-tat, but it required US escalation first.

I think the tide has turned.

Iran now needs to escalate to the point that the US is either forced to retaliate or they have to surrender. Logically speaking, they won’t let Trump “low key” the conflict until the midterms.
